# healthchecksio_pings (Data Source)

The logged pings of one check, the newest first. A free account keeps 100 pings, and a paid account keeps 1000. This data source needs a read-write API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecksio_pings" "backup" {
  check_id = healthchecksio_check.backup.id
}

output "last_ping_type" {
  value = data.healthchecksio_pings.backup.pings[0].type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) The check: its unique_key (the `id` of `healthchecksio_check`) or its UUID.

### Read-Only

- `pings` (Attributes List) The pings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pings))

<a id="nestedatt--pings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pings`

Read-Only:

- `date` (String) The time of the ping (RFC 3339).
- `duration` (Number) The time from the start signal to this signal, in seconds, or null.
- `has_body` (Boolean) True when the server keeps a body for this ping.
- `method` (String) The HTTP method of the ping.
- `n` (Number) The number of the ping. Use it with `healthchecksio_ping_body`.
- `remote_addr` (String) The address of the sender.
- `rid` (String) The run ID of the ping, or null.
- `scheme` (String) The scheme of the ping: `http`, `https` or `email`.
- `type` (String) The kind of the ping, for example `success`, `start`, `fail` or `log`.
- `ua` (String) The user agent of the sender.
